info.name: Leaderboard API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Leader-board backend project.

Base URL: http://localhost:9000/api/v1

## Flow:
1. Register a user
2. Login
3. Create a contest
4. Add problems to the contest
5. Submit a solution
6. Check the leaderboard

request.description:
Register a new user.

Required fields:
- name (string)
- email (string, unique)
- password (string)
Register a second user for testing submissions and leaderboard.

Login with existing user credentials.

Required fields:
- email (string)
- password (string)

Create a new contest.

Required fields:
- title (string)

Optional fields:
- start_time (date ISO string)
- end_time (date ISO string)

⚠️ Save the `contest_id` from the response — you'll need it for creating problems and submissions.
Create a second contest for testing.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Two Sum",
    "Test": "Input: [2,7,11,15], target=9 | Output: [0,1]",
    "contest_id": "PASTE_CONTEST_ID_HERE",
    "description": "Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution.",
    "max_score": 100,
    "max_time": 2000
}

request.description:
Create a single problem for a contest.

Required fields:
- contest_id (string) — from Create Contest response
- description (string)
- max_score (number)
- max_time (number, in ms)

Optional fields:
- name (string)
- Test (string)

⚠️ Replace `PASTE_CONTEST_ID_HERE` with an actual contest_id.

Create multiple problems at once for a contest.

Required fields:
- contest_id (string)
- problems (array, min 1 item)
  - Each problem needs: name, description, max_score, max_time
  - Optional: Test

⚠️ Replace `PASTE_CONTEST_ID_HERE` with an actual contest_id.

body.raw:
{
    "user_id": "PASTE_USER_ID_HERE",
    "problem_id": "PASTE_PROBLEM_ID_HERE",
    "contest_id": "PASTE_CONTEST_ID_HERE",
    "language": "cpp",
    "code": "#include<iostream>\nusing namespace std;\nint main(){\n    int a,b;\n    cin>>a>>b;\n    cout<<a+b;\n    return 0;\n}",
    "score": 100,
    "status": "Accepted"
}

request.description:
Submit a code solution.

Required fields:
- user_id (string)
- problem_id (string)
- contest_id (string)
- language (string) — e.g. 'cpp', 'python', 'java', 'javascript'
- code (string)
- score (number)
- status (string) — e.g. 'Accepted', 'Wrong Answer', 'TLE', 'Runtime Error'

⚠️ Replace all PASTE_*_HERE with actual IDs from previous responses.
Submit a Python solution for testing.

body.raw:
{
    "user_id": "PASTE_USER_ID_HERE",
    "problem_id": "PASTE_PROBLEM_ID_HERE",
    "contest_id": "PASTE_CONTEST_ID_HERE",
    "language": "javascript",
    "code": "const readline = require('readline');\nconst rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin });\nrl.on('line', (line) => { console.log('wrong'); });",
    "score": 0,
    "status": "Wrong Answer"
}

request.description: Test a Wrong Answer submission to see how the system handles failures.

Get the current leaderboard data.

No request body needed — just a simple GET request.
